properties.description: Defined by the absence of electric instrumentation and dependency on acoustics, acoustic music genre includes acoustic versions of songs from other genres. Often characterized by its simplicity and personal/lyrical narratives.
properties.history: Derived in the mid-20th century, acoustic music refers generally to music that uses instruments which produce sound through acoustic means, as opposed to electric or electronic means.
properties.performance: Mostly performed live and can often involve only one or two musicians
properties.rhythm: Typically straightforward, can be complex depending on the artist or style
properties.vocals: Can range from soft and smooth to rough and raspy depending on the artist or style
